phrases.def: 或可预防的可预防的可预防的

sentences.en: Discovered in the early 1800s and named ‘nicotianine’, the oily essence now called nicotine is the main active ingredient of tobacco.
sentences.zh: 油脂质现被称为尼古丁, 也是烟草的主要活性成分。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Nicotine, however, is only a small component of cigarette smoke, which contains more than 4,700 chemical compounds, including 43 cancer-causing substances.
sentences.zh: 然而,尼古丁只是烟雾中很小的一部分,烟雾含有4 700多种化学化合物,包括43种致癌物质。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: In recent times, scientific research has been providing evidence that years of cigarette smoking vastly increases the risk of developing fatal medical conditions.
sentences.zh: 近些年来,科学研究一直提供证据表明,多年来吸烟大大增加了发展致命医疗条件的风险。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In addition to being responsible for more than 85 per cent of lung cancers, smoking is associated with cancers of, amongst others, the mouth, stomach and kidneys, and is thought to cause about 14 per cent of leukemia and cervical cancers.
sentences.zh: 吸烟除了造成85%以上的肺癌之外,还与口腔、胃和肾等癌症有关,并被认为导致约14%的白血病和宫颈癌。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: In 1990, smoking caused more than 84,000 deaths, mainly resulting from such problems as pneumonia, bronchitis and influenza.
sentences.zh: 1990年,吸烟造成84,000多人死亡,主要是肺炎、支气管炎和流感等问题造成的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Smoking, it is believed, is responsible for 30 per cent of all deaths from cancer and clearly represents the most important preventable cause of cancer in countries like the United States today.
sentences.zh: 据认为,吸烟是造成癌症死亡总数的30%,显然是美国等国家目前可以预防的癌症的最重要原因。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Passive smoking, the breathing in of the side-stream smoke from the burning of tobacco between puffs or of the smoke exhaled by a smoker, also causes a serious health risk.
sentences.zh: 被动吸烟、烟花间烟雾燃烧或烟民吸入烟雾时的呼吸,也造成严重的健康风险。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: A report published in 1992 by the US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) emphasized the health dangers, especially from side-stream smoke.
sentences.zh: 美国环境保护署1992年发表的一份报告强调了健康危险,特别是来自边流烟雾的危险。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This type of smoke contains more smaller particles and is therefore more likely to be deposited deep in the lungs.
sentences.zh: 这种烟雾含有较小的粒子,因此更有可能沉入肺深处。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: On the basis of this report, the EPA has classified environmental tobacco smoke in the highest risk category for causing cancer.
sentences.zh: 根据这份报告,环保局将环境烟草烟雾列为致癌风险最高类别。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: As an illustration of the health risks, in the case of a married couple where one partner is a smoker and one a non-smoker, the latter is believed to have a 30 per cent higher risk of death from heart disease because of passive smoking.
sentences.zh: 健康风险的一个例子是,已婚夫妇一方吸烟,一方不吸烟,后者因被动吸烟而死于心脏病的风险高30%。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The risk of lung cancer also increases over the years of exposure and the figure jumps to 80 per cent if the spouse has been smoking four packs a day for 20 years.
sentences.zh: 多年来,肺癌的风险也随着接触而增加,如果配偶20年来每天抽4包烟,这一数字将上升至80%。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: It has been calculated that 17 per cent of cases of lung cancer can be attributed to high levels of exposure to second-hand tobacco smoke during childhood and adolescence.
sentences.zh: 据计算,17%的肺癌病例可归因于在童年和青春期中接触二手烟烟的高度。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A more recent study by researchers at the University of California at San Francisco (UCSF) has shown that second-hand cigarette smoke does more harm to non-smokers than to smokers.
sentences.zh: 旧金山加利福尼亚大学(加州大学)研究人员最近进行的一项研究表明,二手烟烟对非吸烟者比对吸烟者更有害。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Leaving aside the philosophical question of whether anyone should have to breathe someone else’s cigarette smoke, the report suggests that the smoke experienced by many people in their daily lives is enough to produce substantial adverse effects on a person’s heart and lungs.
sentences.zh: 撇开是否应该呼吸别人烟雾的哲学问题, 报告认为许多人日常生活中经历的烟雾足以对人的心脏和肺部产生严重的不利影响。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The report, published in the Journal of the American Medical Association (AMA), was based on the researchers’ own earlier research but also includes a review of studies over the past few years.
sentences.zh: 该报告发表在《美国医学协会杂志》上,是根据研究人员自己早先的研究编写的,但也包括过去几年对研究的审查。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The American Medical Association represents about half of all US doctors and is a strong opponent of smoking.
sentences.zh: 美国医学协会代表了美国医生的一半左右,是强烈反对吸烟的对手。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The study suggests that people who smoke cigarettes are continually damaging their cardiovascular system, which adapts in order to compensate for the effects of smoking.
sentences.zh: 研究表明,吸烟者不断破坏心血管系统,而心血管系统为弥补吸烟的影响而调整。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It further states that people who do not smoke do not have the benefit of their system adapting to the smoke inhalation.
sentences.zh: 它还说,不吸烟的人不能受益于适应吸入烟雾的系统。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Consequently, the effects of passive smoking are far greater on non-smokers than on smokers.
sentences.zh: 因此,被动吸烟对非吸烟者的影响远远大于对吸烟者的影响。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This report emphasizes that cancer is not caused by a single element in cigarette smoke; harmful effects to health are caused by many components.
sentences.zh: 本报告强调,癌症不是烟雾中单一元素造成的;许多元素对健康造成有害影响。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Carbon monoxide, for example, competes with oxygen in red blood cells and interferes with the blood’s ability to deliver life-giving oxygen to the heart.
sentences.zh: 例如一氧化碳与红细胞中的氧相竞争, 并干扰血液向心脏提供救生氧的能力。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

words.def: 氧化二氧化二氧化二氧化三

sentences.en: Nicotine and other toxins in cigarette smoke activate small blood cells called platelets, which increases the likelihood of blood clots, thereby affecting blood circulation throughout the body.
sentences.zh: 烟雾中的尼古丁和其他毒素激活了小血细胞,叫做小小小血细胞,增加了血凝块的可能性,从而影响到整个身体的血液循环。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: The researchers criticize the practice of some scientific consultants who work with the tobacco industry for assuming that cigarette smoke has the same impact on smokers as it does on non-smokers.
sentences.zh: 研究人员批评一些科学顾问的做法,他们与烟草业合作,认为烟雾对吸烟者的影响与对非吸烟者的影响相同。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: They argue that those scientists are underestimating the damage done by passive smoking and, in support of their recent findings, cite some previous research which points to passive smoking as the cause for between 30,000 and 60,000 deaths from heart attacks each year in the United States.
sentences.zh: 他们辩称,这些科学家低估了被动吸烟造成的损害,并为了支持他们最近的调查结果,援引了先前的一些研究,其中指出,被动吸烟是美国每年因心脏病发作而死亡30 000至60 000人的原因。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This means that passive smoking is the third most preventable cause of death after active smoking and alcohol-related diseases.
sentences.zh: 这意味着,被动吸烟是继主动吸烟和与酒精有关的疾病之后第三最可预防的死亡原因。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The study argues that the type of action needed against passive smoking should be similar to that being taken against illegal drugs and AIDS (SIDA).
sentences.zh: 研究报告认为,反对被动吸烟所需采取的行动类型应当类似于针对非法毒品和艾滋病采取的行动(瑞典国际开发署)。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The UCSF researchers maintain that the simplest and most cost-effective action is to establish smoke-free work places, schools and public places.
sentences.zh: 团结和团结团结团结基金研究人员认为,最简单和最具成本效益的行动是建立无烟工作场所、学校和公共场所。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。
